query:
UPDATE auth_providers
        SET disabled_at = CASE WHEN $1 THEN NULL ELSE now() END
        WHERE kind = 'local'
            AND (
                $1
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM auth_providers
                    WHERE kind <> 'local' AND disabled_at IS NULL
                )
            )
        RETURNING disabled_at IS NULL AS "enabled!"
